verdict.rationale: Every Gitea instance ships a versioned /api/v1 REST API with a machine-readable Swagger 2.0 spec (342 paths) and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec. It also has an interactive Swagger UI that is enabled by default, and an API usage guide covering authentication and pagination; the API is also wrapped by an official go-sdk and the tea CLI. The probe 404s at docs.gitea.com paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served per instance and was live-verified on gitea.com. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation or backward-compatibility policy, a documented hosted test/sandbox instance, and independent community corroboration of driving the API.
